In a workshop there are five machines and the probability of any
one of them to be out of service on a day is $\frac{1}{4}$. If the
probability that at most two machines will be out of service on the same
day is $\left( \frac{3}{4} \right)^{3}k$, is equal to
solution:
Required probability = when no. machine has fault + when only
one machine has fault + when only two machines have fault.
$= \ ^{5}C_{0}\left( \frac{3}{4} \right)^{5} + \ ^{5}C_{1}\left( \frac{1}{4} \right)\left( \frac{3}{4} \right)^{4} + \ ^{5}C_{2}\left( \frac{1}{4} \right)^{2}\left( \frac{3}{4} \right)^{3}$
$= \frac{243}{1024} + \frac{405}{1024} + \frac{270}{1024} = \frac{918}{1024} = \frac{459}{512} = \frac{27 \times 17}{64 \times 8}$
$= \left( \frac{3}{4} \right)^{3} \times k = \left( \frac{3}{4} \right)^{3} \times \frac{17}{8}$
$\therefore k = \frac{17}{8}$
